paper_title: Тенденции в производителността на труда в българската минна индустрия
caption: Производителност на труда в подсектор „Добивна промишленост“
model_annotation:
The graph illustrates the changes in labor productivity over the years from 2008 to 2018, comparing two different measures. The x-axis is labeled "Година" (Year) and spans from 2008 to 2018 with a linear scale, marked at each year. The y-axis is labeled "Производителност на труда, хил.лв на заето лице" (Labor Productivity, thousand BGN per employed person) and ranges from 0 to 160, with a linear scale and markings at intervals of 20.

The blue line, representing "Производителност на труда (Приходи от дейността на заето лице)" (Labor Productivity based on Revenue from Activity per Employed Person), starts at 134.678 in 2008, drops to 80.431 in 2009, and then increases to 100.965 in 2010. It continues to rise to 124.679 in 2011, 127.524 in 2012, and 126.888 in 2013, before decreasing to 110.579 in 2014, 114.566 in 2015, and 112.844 in 2016. The line then surges to 139.563 in 2017 and slightly decreases to 138.526 in 2018.

The orange line, representing "Производителност на труда (Добавена стойност по факторни разходи на заето лице)" (Labor Productivity based on Value Added per Employed Person), begins at 30.758 in 2008, increases to 34.300 in 2009, and further rises to 48.642 in 2010, 63.564 in 2011, and 66.622 in 2012. It then drops to 53.025 in 2013, followed by 48.079 in 2014, 46.466 in 2015, and 47.421 in 2016. The line increases again to 65.018 in 2017 and slightly decreases to 62.504 in 2018.
